items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: Theo, bro, from out of St. James Parish, but I never did know him. That was my daddy's daddy.

ctx.x: And I understand my grandfather used to play. Theo, bro, from out of St. James Parish, but I never did know him. That was my daddy's daddy. I understand he played violin years back. And then, well, I had some other relatives. Ruffin Walker played for a while. That's a cousin of mine. He was a- Yeah, Ruffin Walker. Yeah, he was a trumpet player. He had his armband out there in St. James Parish, too. But he didn't play too long. He went into contracting business with Rick Masonry. And he did pretty well for…
Who did they play with out there? Did they play with any other bands other than their own?
